_readme: Nightly job on top of the KillFeed core. Clips come from KillFeed's own settings (%APPDATA%\KillFeed\settings.json): shorts are uploaded from <output>\Publish, recaps from <output>\Recaps. A short is uploaded only if kills >= min_kills OR vehicles >= min_vehicles; best score first, max_per_run per night, scheduled at publish_times (uploaded private with publishAt). Recaps: max_recaps_per_run per night as normal videos, public at recap_publish_time. Dedup against earlier uploads (same kill by clock time). Queue older than queue_max_age_days is retired. Empty queue: best single kill goes through as fallback. cleanup: uploaded clips are deleted after uploaded_clip_days; fully clipped recordings after source_days (0 = never).
description: Gaming clips from ThatsBonkers – mostly WARDOGS helicopter flying, plus whatever else I’m playing. Same guy as ThatsBonkers on the WARDOGS Discord. #gaming #shorts #wardogs #thatsbonkers
recap_description: Daily WARDOGS recap from ThatsBonkers – every kill of the day in order, cut automatically by KillFeed. #wardogs #gaming #thatsbonkers
